full_prompt_en: A square expressionist painted portrait brings one angular face close to the viewer, framed by a teal field on the left and a muted rose field on the right. The head and upper shoulders nearly fill the frame, with dark spiky hair pressed against the top edge. Broad yellow marks cross the forehead and run down the left side of the nose and cheek. Cool blue green, gray and charcoal planes build the opposite side, giving the face a fractured, asymmetrical structure. Two very large pale eyes look outward. Their dark circular rims and uneven pupils sit beneath heavy brows, and deep shadow pools below the lower lids. A long narrow nose divides the face, ending above a small closed mouth outlined in black and touched with muted pink and ochre. The ears appear as dark angular wedges beside the cheeks. At the bottom, a few rust brown shoulder and blue collar shapes emerge without resolving into detailed clothing. The left background is a rough turquoise surface with scraped dark marks, while the right is a mottled pink-red plane. A near-black vertical division runs behind the head and intensifies the contrast between the two sides. The paint looks dry and worked over, with scratches, dragged color and uneven thickness visible in both face and background. Light is not a single realistic beam; brightness is carried by the sharp yellow planes and white eyes, while black contours and blue gray recesses provide forceful shadow. The gaze remains still despite the restless surface. The overall composition makes a pale pair of eyes and a severe yellow line the focus within a tight conflict of warm and cool color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义绘画肖像把一张棱角面孔推近观者，左侧由青绿色域框住，右侧是低饱和玫瑰色域。头部与上肩几乎填满画面，深色尖乱头发贴近上边缘。宽大的黄笔痕横过额头，再沿鼻子和左脸颊向下。冷蓝绿、灰和炭黑平面搭成另一半，使面部呈破碎而不对称的结构。两只很大的浅色眼睛望向画外。深圆眼圈与不均匀瞳孔坐在浓眉之下，下眼睑处聚着深影。细长鼻梁分割面孔，落在一张由黑线圈住、点有低饱和粉色和赭色的小闭嘴上方。耳朵像深色棱形楔块立在双颊旁。底部少量锈褐肩形和蓝领口露出，却没有解析为细致衣物。左背景是带刮磨深痕的粗青绿表面，右边是斑驳粉红平面。近黑竖向分割线立在头后，加剧两侧对照。颜料显得干涩且反复加工，脸与背景都有刮痕、拖色和不均匀厚度。光不是单一写实光束；明亮由锐利黄色平面与白眼承担，黑轮廓和蓝灰凹处提供有力阴影。尽管表面躁动，目光仍静止。整体构图让一双浅眼和一条严峻黄线成为冷暖色紧密冲突中的焦点。
style_prompt_en: The image has a rough expressionist painting surface marked by dragged pigment, scratches and strong dark contours. Saturated yellow cuts through teal, blue gray, charcoal and muted rose fields, with a few near-white accents creating concentrated focus. Forms are assembled from angular, uneven planes rather than smooth continuous gradients. Asymmetry and abrupt color changes make the surface restless, while broad vertical masses keep the composition stable. Light is encoded in flat bright strokes against dark recessed areas instead of obeying a realistic source. Edges vary from thick black lines to scuffed transitions where colors scrape into one another. The space is compressed and shallow, pulling all painted activity toward the front. The overall effect is intense and tactile, with fractured warm-cool color and visible revisions of the brush carrying the emotional force.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有粗粝表现主义绘画表面，拖拽颜料、刮痕和强深轮廓清楚可见。饱和黄切过青绿、蓝灰、炭黑和低饱和玫瑰色域，少量近白强调集中焦点。形体由棱角、不均匀平面拼成，而非平滑连续渐变。不对称与突然换色使表面躁动，宽阔竖向团块仍稳住构图。光被编码在平涂亮笔痕与深凹区域的对照中，不服从写实光源。边缘从粗黑线变化到颜色彼此刮入的擦损过渡。空间压缩且浅，所有绘画活动都被拉向前方。整体效果强烈而可触，破碎冷暖色彩和可见的反复笔改承载情绪力量。
theme_en: An angular wide-eyed face painted in yellow, teal and charcoal against split colored fields
theme_zh: 一张棱角分明、圆眼的面孔以黄、青绿和炭色绘出，背后是分割色域
name: Francis Newton Souza
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
